channel.title: Comments for page "5th Global Occult Coalition Donation"
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "5th Global Occult Coalition Donation"

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: This is so cool. I knew MCF had untapped potential, but I didn't expect it to be quite this good. I like that you've made them more than the naive idiots they're portrayed as in articles, but you've still managed to retain their status as a smaller player in the universe by having the other GOIs use them to improve their own image, while sending them their old tat they don't really want to deal with. Good show.

item.title: NGO with a MECHA. 'Nuff said.
item.content:encoded:
Second jab at MCF items. This one is a re-imagining of a GOC tool (obviously), the Orange Suit, referred to in DrClef's Global Occult Coalition Canon and, I believe, created by schifter.

The GOC background image is something I put together manipulating CC-compliant vector images, so I think it's fair play to use them on the wiki, even if it is basically a reproduction of the GOC logo Aelanna created for the GOC Canon. :3
